name: Free Spirit Media Teen Programs
what_you_do: Teens learn screenwriting, editing, camera work, audio and acting. Programs run after school, in school and in summer. Teens also get job skills training.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 11 to 18. The page describes participants as middle and high school artists ages 11-18.
pay_detail: Stipend for program completion, plus snacks and Ventra transit passes. Amount not stated.
duration: Fall 2026 programs run Sept 21 to Nov 20, 2026; also after-school, in-school and summer offerings
deadline_text: Fall 2026 programs: Sept 21 to Nov 20, 2026. Registration deadline not stated.
how_to_apply: Use the "Register for programs here" button on the Programs page. Questions: programs@freespiritmedia.org.
notes: Older teens 18 and up can look at the Creative Pathways job program (ages 18 to 25). The page does not say if sign-up is still open for fall, so contact the program. The Illinois FAQ requires work permits only for workers under 16. It refers 16 and 17 year olds to federal rules.
